rule_metadata.author: frack113
rule_metadata.title: Add Authorized Applications to Microsoft Defender Firewall via Registry

rules.rule_text:
title: Add Authorized Applications to Microsoft Defender Firewall via Registry
id: 6648f900-4a7d-47e3-bad6-952b313a1c0e
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the degradation of the system firewall security by the creation
  or re-enabling of per-application

  exceptions via registry writes to the AuthorizedApplications\List keys under FirewallPolicy,
  which grants

  the targeted executable network access and can be abused by malware to bypass network
  restrictions.

  '
references:
- https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/da209017000b9812e8bc5f4e8db6499430ee2aadc72ef896964cffdfd896f143/behavior
- https://app.any.run/tasks/8d4113a8-5403-4367-a79f-4ce4978d9bdb
- https://www.trendmicro.com/vinfo/us/threat-encyclopedia/malware/trojan.win32.zbot.e
- https://www.greatis.com/appdata/d/q/qykernel.exe.htm
- https://www.scanspyware.net/spyware-sub/spyware-removal/MarketScore-RelevantKnowledge
author: frack113
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
- attack.defense-impairment
- attack.t1686.003
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains|all:
    - \Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\
    - \AuthorizedApplications\List
    Details|contains: ':Enabled:'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: medium
regression_tests_path: regression_data/rules/windows/registry/registry_set/registry_set_defender_firewall_add_exception/info.yml
